# Real CI alias routing evidence

`ci-only.capture.json` and `outdated-framework.capture.json` are generated by `node test/lib/setup-alias-replay.js --capture`. The capture owner launches `cli/skill-runner.js` with the actual CI alias and the repository-default Codex model against a private scratch project, then reads the emitted hook events, persistent facts, selected step, journal and pipeline. Both skills have customization overrides in the project. The outdated sibling contains the authentic `bmad-testarch-framework/SKILL.md` from tag `v2.0.0` (`cf325a7948220058208339587b917cb1a4d4ae60`).

The installer replays both cases without a live model call. Its oracle checks hook ownership and greeting order, CI scope and routing, journal completion, executable test commands, and the incompatible sibling's upgrade offer. Captures pin the alias files and canonical activation/routing/state plus CI Create inputs consumed by these cases. A change to those inputs invalidates the capture and requires refreshing it through its owner. Unrelated framework Create, Edit and Validate source changes leave these evidence pins unchanged.

The capture owner retains each full scratch project and reports its path. All helper scripts and temporary files must stay in that project or a fresh private `mkdtemp` directory. Do not edit capture JSON by hand.
